subtasks.title: PO rejection repair: rebuild standalone Image Studio UI
subtasks.description: Rebuild Phase 6 Image Studio UI to close six PO-rejected foundational gaps: aspect ratio selector, token economics and insufficient-balance UI, conversational slash-command interface, generation error/scoring visibility, style/prompt library, and multi-format export.
subtasks.details:
SIZE: L. Evidence: standalone Image Studio repair is expected to touch more than 10 frontend/test/internal-record files, no new DB tables planned, no new external integrations, but it rebuilds a product subsystem surface around the existing Art Director backend contract. Required phases: 0 through 8. FOUNDATIONAL FIX ANALYSIS: Q1 Origin: ORIGIN Layer 6 Frontend UI composition and Layer 7 frontend state/API orchestration; SPEC PRD V5 Addendum Section 26 defines standalone Image Studio with conversational interface, style/prompt library, export, and canvas workspace; Architecture Lock v6.1 Sections 2 through 6 define scoring, token economics, feature flag, mode/platform constraints, and observability; ACTUAL prior completion provided a thin generation wrapper around repaired schemas. Q2 Layers: symptom Layer 6 Frontend UI; root cause layers Layer 6 UI, Layer 7 client state/API orchestration, Layer 5 API contract consumption, Layer 10 config/feature flag surfacing, Layer 11 user-visible errors/observability metadata, Layer 13 tests/validation. Q3 Class prevention: patch approach would add isolated controls to the command panel; foundational approach chosen is to model Image Studio as an end-to-end standalone design workspace with typed mode/aspect/billing/library/export/error/scoring state so future backend schema binding cannot be mistaken for product completion. Q4 Spec gap: none blocking; sources are explicit. Architecture Lock v6.1 is backend-scoped and labels frontend as Phase 6; PRD Section 26 governs the UI. Q5 Blast radius: frontend Image Studio route/components/tests and existing billing/router metadata only; no destructive DB migration; risk medium because UI workflow changes are broad but additive around existing API contracts. APPROVED TO PROCEED: yes to Phase 2 architecture plan, no code until PO approves plan.

PHASE 2 ARCHITECTURE PLAN: Completed and saved at docs/internal/phase6-repair/PHASE6_IMAGE_STUDIO_REPAIR_ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md. Plan audits current ImageStudio monolith, studio contract, shared Art Director schema, API wrapper, tests, and billing modal; confirms no product-code changes yet. Proposed repair rebuilds Studio as standalone design workspace with Studio Library and Mode Planner, Conversational Composer, Canvas and Generation Inspector, explicit generation state machine, billing/token preflight, mode-aware aspect/platform selector, error/scoring visibility, style/prompt library, and export controls. Awaiting PO approval before implementation.

subtasks.title: Verify PO Condition 1: editing-router path coverage and deferred gap logging if Visual Engine editing bypasses routeGeneration
subtasks.details:
<info added on 2026-04-29T18:59:19.845Z>
PO Condition 1 has been verified prior to implementation. The editing-router.ts file functions as a contract-only module and does not execute operations or trigger billing. Current Visual Engine V2 editing operations enter the routeGeneration process via input.editingTool. The image-router.ts module constructs the editing pipeline steps, selects editing providers, saves editing-aware metadata, and ensures that the non-cached path reaches the routeGeneration billing gate. A comprehensive repository-wide scan confirmed that there is no separate non-test editing execution endpoint outside of artDirector.routeGeneration. Based on the current source evidence, no additional billing-gap task is necessary. Future direct editing execution paths must reuse the Task 71 token-economics primitives to maintain consistency. Evidence supporting this verification includes apps/worker/src/lib/ai/editing-router.ts, apps/worker/src/lib/ai/image-router.ts, and the file /tmp/task71_condition1_deep_check.txt.
</info added on 2026-04-29T18:59:19.845Z>

subtasks.title: Verify PO Condition 2: frontend insufficient-token metadata reads preserved tRPC cause or explicit data propagation
subtasks.details:
<info added on 2026-04-29T19:00:18.119Z>
PO Condition 2 verification confirms that the frontend Studio API wrapper currently reads error codes from body.error.data.code or body.error.code only. The Art Director tRPC router maps ApiError status 402 to tRPC FORBIDDEN and preserves the original ApiError in the cause property. However, the client wrapper does not read cause.code and should not rely on tRPC serializing the cause. To address this, Task 71 must implement explicit propagation of insufficient-token metadata at the API boundary. Additionally, the Studio client handling must be updated to detect INSUFFICIENT_TOKENS errors explicitly rather than treating them as generic FORBIDDEN errors. Relevant code references include apps/worker/src/trpc/routers/art-director.ts, apps/web/src/lib/studio-api.ts, and verification evidence in /tmp/task71_condition_verification_grep.txt.
</info added on 2026-04-29T19:00:18.119Z>
<info added on 2026-04-29T19:00:46.739Z>
Diagnostic evidence for PO Condition 2 confirms that the frontend Studio API wrapper currently reads only trpc error data.code or code fields and does not access the preserved cause.code from the tRPC error. This necessitates explicit propagation of insufficient-token metadata at the API boundary to ensure accurate detection and handling of INSUFFICIENT_TOKENS errors, rather than relying on generic FORBIDDEN error mapping. This diagnostic finding underscores the requirement for Task 71 to implement explicit metadata propagation and update client error handling accordingly.
</info added on 2026-04-29T19:00:46.739Z>

subtasks.title: Wire Layer 4/8 backend token economics: estimate metadata, balance preflight, atomic post-success deduction, reconciliation notes
subtasks.details:
<info added on 2026-04-29T19:23:11.104Z>
The backend billing foundation for Task 71 has been implemented. The image-router now reuses token-engine primitives to provide provider-cost estimates, perform billing freeze checks, conduct balance preflight validations, and handle insufficient-token ApiError details. It also supports atomic deductTokens operations following successful non-cached Art Director executions. Cached Pattern DB hits continue to be free_cache with tokenAction set to none. Deduction metadata now records traceId, asset save status, mode, editingTool, selected model, provider tier/gateway, fallback reason, and cache status to support reconciliation. Targeted backend route-generation tests and full worker tests have passed successfully.
</info added on 2026-04-29T19:23:11.104Z>
